subject: Social Studies
stem: A farm labourer who has work only during sowing and harvesting seasons, remaining without work for the rest of the year, is an example of which type of unemployment?
explanation: Seasonal unemployment occurs when work is available only during certain periods of the year (like agricultural sowing/harvest seasons) — distinct from disguised unemployment (more workers than needed on a task) or structural unemployment (skill mismatch).

subject: Social Studies
stem: The minimum level of income needed to meet a person's basic needs (food, clothing, shelter), used to classify a population as poor or not poor, is called the:
explanation: The poverty line is the income threshold below which a person is classified as poor, based on the estimated cost of basic minimum needs — distinct from per capita income (average income per person) or GDP growth rate.
